working_definition: Tm3 is a narrow-field transmedullary columnar neuron of the adult Drosophila optic lobe. It arborises in medulla layers M1, M4, M5, M9, and M10 and terminates in lobula layers 1 and 4 with bleb-like morphology. It receives input from lamina monopolar neurons L1 and L5 and medulla intrinsic neuron Mi1, and outputs to T4 neurons, placing it in the ON motion detection pathway. It is capable of both cholinergic and GABAergic neurotransmission.

best_match.fbbt_definition: Transmedullary narrow field neuron that terminates in lobula layers 1 and 4 with bleb-like terminal arborizations. It has fine arborizations in medulla layers M1, M4, and M5, and has bleb-type arborization in medulla layers M1, M4, M9 and M10 (Morante and Desplan, 2008; Fischbach and Dittrich, 1989). Pre-synaptic terminals are present mainly in medulla layers M9-M10, but also in all other layers where neurites extend laterally (Pankova and Borst, 2017). It receives input from lamina monopolar neuron L1 and L5 and medullary intrinsic neuron Mi1 and it outputs to T4 neurons (Takemura et al., 2013). It seems to be capable of both cholinergic (Pankova and Borst, 2017) and GABAergic (Raghu et al., 2013) neurotransmission.

justification: The cluster label 'Tm3' corresponds directly to the canonical adult Drosophila optic lobe neuron FBbt:00003791 'transmedullary neuron Tm3' (also known as Tm3a). The FBbt definition matches precisely on all key features: narrow-field transmedullary morphology, medulla layer arborisations (M1, M4, M5, M9, M10), lobula layer terminals (layers 1 and 4), connectivity (input from L1, L5, Mi1; output to T4), and dual cholinergic/GABAergic neurotransmitter identity. The Kurmangaliyev 2020 atlas profiles adult optic lobe cells, consistent with this being the mature adult form. The closely related FBbt:00110071 (Tm3b) is distinguished by an additional M8 branch and is a distinct subtype; FBbt:00052329 is the immature developmental form, not the adult; and FBbt:00003830 (Tm3Y) is a transmedullary Y neuron and a separate cell class.
